problems: OCR block reordering/duplication around cols 761-775: the Relatio, Prostagma and Antirrhetici pages occur at lines 55871-56281, then the Confessio pages (761-766) and a second copy of Relatio/Prostagma/Antirrhetici at 57385-57789. First bodyLines given; Confessio only appears (line 57052) after the first copy.

Elenchus numbers are missing for the Homiliae, Monumenta/Monitum, Encomium Philothei, Nili panegyricus and all three Acindynus items; the detached blocks '679 619 693 1717 163 161 109 113' were mapped to the Tomi/Confessio/Relatio/Rescriptum/Antirrhetici in order (inferred).

Ordo-only editorial: 'Notitia historica' (Gregorius Acindynus, Ordo 1187; head near line 88752, col ~1186/1187) is not in the Elenchus; not entered. Ordo also lists 'Jacobi Gretseri praefatio' 1189 and Liber I/II chapter lists (not entered).

Homily collection: Ordo columns for many homilies are garbled or missing (e.g. XIII '51', XV '477', XXIII '1291', XXIX '5365'); parts carry ordoCol as read. Hom. I body col inferred as 1 (Ordo reads 9).
Greek flag for Homiliae/Tomi/Barlaam items assigned from heads seen; Barlaam letters show only Latin pages (PRO LATINIS running heads).
